blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Generalizing deepfake detection across facial manipulation and fully generated video remains challenging due to forgery traces varying with the manipulation method and scene content. Explicit spatial and temporal feature differences offer a way to capture this variation, but also respond to natural texture and motion, motivating their joint interpretation with appearance features. We investigate whether combining multiscale feature differences with adapted appearance representations improves detection across both forgery categories. We introduce Multiscale Appearance-Residual Streams (MARS), a two-path video detector. The residual path applies fixed spatial and temporal difference-of-Gaussians operators to frozen intermediate features and models the resulting differences alongside appearance context across frames. The semantic path adapts the encoder's normalization parameters for frame classification, and a clip-dependent gate combines their predictions. Under a shared protocol across seven datasets, MARS achieves the highest average AUROC of 91.43\%, outperforming seven compared detectors. When trained on facial manipulations alone, MARS achieves 93.99\% AUROC on GenVideo and 75.50\% on DF26, demonstrating transfer to generated videos without generated-video training data. MARS also provides signed patch and frame contributions, whose faithfulness we evaluate through controlled spatial and temporal removal against random controls. MARS is publicly available for research: Project page: https://vectorinstitute.github.io/mars/ Github: https://github.com/VectorInstitute/mars

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Deepfake detection (DFD) assesses video authenticity across facial manipulations, such as face swapping and reenactment [ 27 ] , and fully generated videos [ 4 ] . Their misuse enables
impersonation and misleading content [ 25 ] , requiring detectors that generalize beyond the forgeries seen during training. Existing approaches to DFD mostly examine spatial residuals [ 20 ] , adjacent-frame inconsistencies [ 8 ] , facial style changes [ 5 ] , or feature dynamics [ 41 ] . Pretrained visual encoders provide complementary appearance features learned through
image–text supervision [ 24 ] or self-supervised objectives [ 9 ] .

blocks.en: One of the common manipulation techniques is facial manipulation, which can introduce localized changes [ 27 ] , whereas fully generated videos may exhibit alterations in appearance and motion across the entire frame [ 4 ] . This variation motivates feature comparisons across spatial neighborhoods and temporal intervals at multiple scales. Seminal works, such as UNITE studies facial manipulation and generated-video detection using pretrained features and attention diversity [ 14 ] . GenD demonstrates the effectiveness of adapting pretrained representations through normalization tuning [ 38 ] . These advances raise a question: do explicit multiscale spatial and temporal feature differences add useful information to adapted appearance representation? Residuals emphasize local variation [ 20 ] , but also respond to natural texture and motion. We therefore investigate their joint use with appearance context for detection across both forgery categories.

To investigate this complementarity, we introduce M ultiscale A ppearance- R esidual S treams ( MARS ), a full-frame detector with two complementary paths ( Fig. 1 ). blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Facial forgery involves altering a person’s identity or expression in a video, and detectors look for forensic cues, the traces these alterations may leave in spatial appearance and across frames, with spatiotemporal inconsistency learning (STIL) combining spatial inconsistencies and adjacent-frame feature differences [ 8 ] , while TI 2 Net and StyleFlow model temporal changes in facial identity and style representations, respectively [ 17 , 5 ] . More recent approaches adapt foundation models for generalizable detection. ForAda supervises a CLIP adapter with blending boundaries derived from manipulation masks [ 7 ] , whereas GenD tunes normalization layers [ 38 ] and DFD-HR selectively processes features through layer pruning, token selection, and expert routing [ 31 ] .
blocks.zh: 表面伪造涉及改变一个人在视频中的身份或表达,探测器寻找法证提示,这些改变的痕迹可能在空间外观和跨框中留下,空间不一致的学习(STIL)结合了空间不一致和相邻框架的特征差异[8],而TI 2 Net和StyleFlow模型在面部特征和样式表现上的时间变化分别[17,5]. 较新的方法调整了基础模型,以便进行普遍的检测。 ForAda监督一个CLIP适配器,其混合边界来自操控口罩[7],而GEND调制正常化层[38]和DFD-HR有选择地通过层穿插,符号选择和专家路由[31]处理特征.

blocks.en: However, these methods use face-cropping, excluding evidence outside facial regions. This limits their direct application to generated videos that may contain no detectable faces or exhibit synthesis artifacts throughout the scene. MARS instead processes full frames and combines appearance representations with multiscale spatial and temporal feature differences.
blocks.zh: 然而,这些方法使用面部剪裁,不包括面部区域以外的证据. 这限制了它们直接应用到生成的视频中,这些视频可能没有可探测的面孔或展示整个场景的合成文物. MARS转而处理全帧并结合外观表现与多尺度的空间和时间特征差异.

blocks.en:
Generated-video detectors examine synthesis traces across the full scene. DeMamba models local spatio-temporal inconsistencies in pretrained visual features [ 4 ] , while WaveRep uses wavelet-based training augmentation to encourage forensic learning [ 6 ] . Other approaches detect deviations in feature trajectories or diffusion-derived spatiotemporal statistics [ 41 , 12 , 40 ] , but primarily evaluate transfer across generators. UNITE addresses both facial manipulation and full-scene synthesis using FF++ and GTA-V training data, full-frame SigLIP features, and an attention-diversity loss [ 14 ] .
MARS shares this unified detection setting but explicitly computes spatial and temporal differences at multiple scales in frozen intermediate features. It combines these differences with adapted appearance representations to examine their complementary value across both forgery categories.

生成-视频探测器检查整个场景的合成痕迹. DeMamba在预训视觉特征中模拟局部的spatio-时态不一致[4],而WaveRep则使用波浪式的训练增强功能来鼓励法医学学习[6]. 其他方法检测特征轨迹偏差或传播衍生的瞬间统计[41、12、40],但主要评价跨发电机的转移。 UNITE利用FF++和GTA-V培训数据、全框架SigLIP特征和注意力多样性损失[14]处理面部操纵和全场合成问题。
MARS共享这种统一的检测设置,但明确在冻结中间特征的多个尺度上计算时空差异. 它将这些差异与经过调整的外观表述结合起来,以检查它们在两种伪造类别中的互补价值。

blocks.en: Explicit forensic representations capture spatial and temporal variation alongside visual content. High-freq combines multiscale high-frequency features with an RGB pathway through residual-guided spatial attention [ 20 ] , while D3 [ 41 ] measures changes in inter-frame feature distances and ReStraV classifies the curvature and stepwise distances of feature trajectories [ 12 ] .

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: Given a video with a video-level real or fake label, our goal is a single full-frame detector that generalizes to facial manipulations and fully generated videos unseen during training. MARS combines explicit spatial and temporal comparisons with pretrained appearance features. Its residual path models multiscale changes in intermediate patch features across the clip, while its semantic path adapts the encoder’s final representation for frame-level classification. A clip-dependent gate combines their predictions, and both paths provide outputs for post-hoc inspection. We provide further details in Appendix A .
blocks.zh: 我们的目标是一个单一的全帧探测器, MARS将明确的空间和时间比较与预先训练的外观特征相结合. 其残存路径模型在中间补丁特征上跨剪辑的多尺度变化,而其语义路径则将编码器的最终表示用于帧级分类. 依靠剪辑的门结合了他们的预测,两条路径都为后热检查提供了输出. 我们在附录A中提供了进一步的细节。

blocks.en: We inspect which regions and frames support MARS’s prediction without an additional explanation model. We decompose the fused margin into signed frame scores, combining the residual classifier’s patch contributions with the semantic frame margins, so that their sum recovers the fused margin. These scores show which features the classifier rely on, not which pixels caused the prediction. Summing the residual contributions over time also gives a 24 × 24 24\times 24 patch map per clip. We evaluate the faithfulness of this evidence through deletion tests [ 23 ] , measuring whether removing highly ranked patches or frames changes predictions more than equal-budget random removal. Sec. A.3 provides the score definitions and evaluation details.

blocks.en:
We train on FF++ c23 [ 27 ] and GTA-V [ 10 ] , and evaluate out-of-domain generalization across facial manipulation and full-scene synthesis using CelebDF-V2 [ 15 ] , DeepFakeTIMIT [ 13 ] , HiFiFace [ 35 ] , UADFV [ 37 ] , GenVideo [ 4 ] , and DF26 [ 29 ] .
After each epoch, we evaluate on the FF++ validation split and select the checkpoint with the highest video-level AUROC, then evaluate it on the source test splits and out-of-domain datasets. Appendix B summarizes the datasets, with their splits and handling.
All methods are trained with a fixed seed for three epochs using AdamW, a learning rate of 10 − 4 10^{-4} , weight decay of 10 − 4 10^{-4} , and an effective batch size of 32 clips. The learning rate is halved every 1,000 optimizer updates. The complete shared training settings are provided in Appendix C .

blocks.en: 4.3.4 Robustness to Processing
blocks.zh: 4.3.4 处理能力

blocks.en:
We evaluate fixed checkpoints under compression, blur, downscaling, and noise to examine whether detection remains effective after video processing ( Fig. 4 ). MARS achieves the highest average AUROC at every tested JPEG quality, retaining 82.47% at quality 40 compared with 77.55% for DFD-HR. It also leads under downscaling to 112 pixels and blur up to σ = 1.5 \sigma=1.5 , although ForAda performs better under stronger blur and downscaling.
Gaussian noise exposes a clearer weakness, with MARS dropping to 70.80% at σ = 0.05 \sigma=0.05 , below DFD-HR’s 74.73%. blocks.en: We visualize the spatial weights and frame scores of MARS ( Fig. 5 ) and test whether removing high-ranked regions or frames affects its predictions more than random removal. On the selected evaluation clips, blanking the 64 highest-attribution patches per frame reduces average AUROC from 99.32% to 73.05%, whereas blanking the same number of random patches leaves it at 98.96% ( Fig. 5(a) ). The larger drop under attribution-guided removal supports the relevance of the spatial ranking to the detector’s decisions.

blocks.en: For temporal evidence, we construct clips containing a 32-frame manipulated segment within authentic footage. Removing the 32 highest-scoring frames reduces the mean fake probability from 34.21% to 21.75%, while random removal leaves it at 35.10% ( Fig. 5(b) ). Removing the known manipulated frames lowers it further to 14.80%, showing that the predicted ranking captures useful temporal evidence but does not fully recover the manipulated segment. Together, these interventions support the relevance of the displayed evidence to MARS’s decisions, without establishing that every highlighted region is a forgery artifact.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We introduced MARS to investigate whether multiscale spatial and temporal feature differences complement adapted appearance representations for detecting facial manipulation and fully generated video. Under a shared protocol across seven datasets, MARS achieves the highest average AUROC among the compared detectors, while training on facial manipulations alone also transfers to generated videos. Ablations show that combining the paths improves facial and overall detection, with benefits that vary across datasets. Controlled removal tests further support the relevance of its signed patch and frame contributions to its predictions. These results support combining explicit feature comparisons with appearance representations for video forgery detection. However, MARS remains sensitive to Gaussian noise, strong blur, and downscaling, while its residual comparisons use fixed scales. Future work could explore adaptive scale and depth selection alongside training for greater robustness to video degradation. Extending MARS beyond visual evidence to incorporate audio to support multimodal forgery detection.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了MARS来调查多尺度的空间和时间特征差异是否补充了用于检测面部操纵和充分生成的视频的适应外观表现. 在一个跨越七个数据集的共享协议下,MARS在比较检测器中实现了最高平均AUROC,而光是面部操纵的培训也转移到生成的视频. 缩写表明,结合路径可以改善面部和整体检测,其好处因数据集而异. 受控清除测试进一步支持其签名补丁的关联性,并对预测做出框架贡献. 这些结果支持将清晰的特征比较与外观表现相结合,用于视频伪造检测. 然而,MARS仍然对高斯噪声敏感,强烈模糊,并有降尺度,而其剩余比较则使用固定尺度. 今后的工作可以探讨适应规模和深度选择,同时进行培训,以提高视频退化的强度。 将MARS的范围扩大到视觉证据以外,纳入音频,以支持多式伪造检测。

blocks.en: A.1 Forward Pass

blocks.en: Following our dual-path architecture, both paths use the same frozen attention and MLP weights of PE-Core-L but differ in depth and normalization parameters. The residual path passes every frame through blocks 1 1 to k k once with the pretrained parameters γ \gamma , and all of its later operations act on the resulting patch tokens. The semantic path passes the T sem T_{\mathrm{sem}} selected frames through all L L blocks with its own parameters γ sem \gamma^{\mathrm{sem}} . Because γ sem \gamma^{\mathrm{sem}} differs from γ \gamma from the first block onward, these frames cannot reuse Z t Z_{t} and are encoded a second time. Besides the fake probability, the forward pass returns the patch weights α \alpha , the per-frame semantic probabilities, the gate weight w w , and the two standardized margins. We summarize the forward path in Algorithm 1 , and Tab. S1 lists the hyperparameters of MARS.

blocks.en: Appendix B Dataset Details
blocks.zh: 附录B 数据集细节

blocks.en:
FaceForensics++ [ 27 ] provides
authentic videos and facial manipulations produced by Deepfakes,
Face2Face, FaceSwap, and NeuralTextures. We use c23 compression and the official splits, comprising 3,600 training videos, 700 validation videos, and 700 test videos. The training split contains 720 authentic videos and 720 videos from each manipulation method, while the validation and test splits each contain 140 authentic videos and 140 videos per method. The validation split is used for checkpoint selection. The videos are YouTube recordings of mostly frontal faces, typically around 480p. The median video has 414 frames at 25 fps (about 17 s) in the training split, 398 frames at 30 fps (about 13 s) in the validation split, and 444 frames at 25 fps (about 18 s) in the test split.
blocks.zh:
FaceForensics++ [27] 提供
真实的视频和面部操纵 由Deepfakes,
Face2Face,FaceSwap,以及神经图解. 我们使用c23压缩和官方分拆,包括3600个训练视频,700个验证视频,700个测试视频. 训练分会包含720个正版视频和来自每种操纵方法的720个视频,而验证和测试分会则分别包含140个正版视频和140个视频. 验证分拆用于检查点选择. 影片是YouTube主要拍摄正面面孔的录音,一般在480p左右. 中位视频在训练分片25英尺(约17秒)有414帧,在验证分片30英尺(约13秒)有398帧,在测试分片25英尺(约18秒)有444帧.

blocks.en: We use rendered sequences from SAIL-VOS 3D [ 10 ] as fully synthetic videos. The training split contains 141 sequences with a median of 336 frames, and the held-out evaluation split contains 30 sequences with a median of 389 frames, all at 1280 × 800 1280\times 800 resolution.
blocks.zh: 我们用SAIL-VOS 3D[10]的序列作为全合成视频. 训练分裂包含141个序列,中位数为336帧,被搁置的评价分裂包含30个序列,中位数为389帧,均以1280×800 1280\时间800分辨率.

CelebDF-V2 [ 15 ] contains face swaps generated
from celebrity interviews. We use its official test list of 518 videos, comprising 340 manipulated videos and 178 authentic videos.
The authentic pool includes 108 celebrity interview videos
and 70 YouTube videos. The evaluated videos are typically around 480p,
at 30 fps, with a median of 372 frames (approximately 12 s).

CelebDF-V2 [15] 包含生成的面额互换
从名人采访。 我们使用518个视频的官方测试清单,包括340个被操纵视频和178个真实视频。

还有70个YouTube视频 被评价的视频一般在480p左右,
在30英尺处,中间值为372帧(约合12秒).

blocks.en:
DeepFakeTIMIT [ 13 ] contains face swaps at two quality levels, with 320 videos
at each level. We pair these 640 manipulated videos with the 320 corresponding VidTIMIT [ 28 ] recordings, giving 960 evaluation videos. The authentic recordings cover 32 subjects reading ten sentences each, and matching uses the subject directory and sentence identifier rather than the inserted identity.
Each authentic recording is stored as a sequence of numbered
JPEG frames, which we read in numerical order as one video.
The manipulated videos have a resolution of 512 × 384 512\times 384 and a frame rate of 25 fps. All videos have a median of 103 frames (about 4 s).
blocks.zh:
深层假象 [13] 包含两个质量级别的面值互换,包含320个视频
每个级别。 我们把这640个被操纵的视频与320个对应的VidTIMIT[28]的录音配对,给出960个评价视频. 作准录音涵盖32个题材,每个题材读十句,配对使用主题目录和句子标识符,而不是插入的身份.
每张正版录音作为编号序列存储
JPEG框架,我们按数字顺序读成一个视频。
被操纵的视频分辨率为512×384 512\times 384,帧率为25 fps. 所有视频的中位数为103帧(约4 s).

blocks.en:
HiFiFace [ 35 ] releases 1,000 face-swapped videos generated from FaceForensics++ footage, without an accompanying authentic-video set. We identify the target video from each filename and retain only swaps whose target index belongs to the official FaceForensics++ test split, excluding targets from the training and validation splits.
Each retained swap is paired with its corresponding c23 authentic target video, giving a balanced evaluation set of 140 authentic and 140 manipulated videos that share the underlying footage. The videos are typically around 480p at 25 fps, with a median of 460 frames (about 18 s).
blocks.zh:
HiFi Face [35] 发布FaceForensics++镜头产生的1000张脸部擦拭视频,没有配套的正视频集. 我们从每个文件名中识别目标视频,只保留目标指数属于FaceForensics++官方测试拆分的互换,不包括培训和验证拆分中的目标.
每次保留的互换都与其相应的c23真实目标视频配对,给出了140个真实和140个被操纵的视频的均衡评价集,共享了基础镜头. 影片一般在25英尺处约480p,中位数为460帧(约18秒).

blocks.en:
UADFV [ 37 ] contains 49 authentic videos
and their 49 face-swapped counterparts. We evaluate all 98 videos. Their resolutions reach approximately 500 pixels on the short side, with a frame rate of 30 fps and a median of 204 frames (about 7 s).
blocks.zh:
UADFV [37] 包含49个真实视频
他们的49个脸部擦伤的对手 我们评价98个视频 它们的分辨率在短侧达到约500像素,帧速率30英尺,中位数204帧(约7秒).

blocks.en:
We use the provided validation split of GenVideo [ 4 ] for evaluation,
containing 18,286 videos in the evaluated manifest. These comprise 10,000 authentic videos and 8,286 generated videos across ten groups: Crafter, Gen2, HotShot, Lavie, ModelScope, MoonValley, MorphStudio, Show-1, Sora, and WildScrape. Group sizes range from 56 videos for Sora to 1,400 for Lavie. We retain the provided authentic-video pool without constructing additional real–fake pairings. The authentic videos have a median of 41 frames at 3 fps (about 14 s). For generated videos, the per-generator median ranges from 8 frames (HotShot) to 450 (Sora), at 8–50 fps. Most generated videos last 1–4 s, while the Sora videos are approximately 15 s long. Although frame rate can act as a shortcut in GenVideo, MARS’s semantic path scores frames independently of their spacing, samples only from genuine frames, and still reaches 93.59% AUROC on GenVideo by itself ( Tab. S13 ), comparable to full MARS (93.44%), so MARS’s transfer does not require this cue.
blocks.zh:
我们利用GenVideo[4]提供的验证分拆进行评估,
载有18 286个录像,在评估的清单上。 其中包括10 000个真实视频和8 286个制作的视频,分为10组:Crafter、Gen2、HotShot、Lavie、ModelScope、MoonValley、MorphStudio、Show-1、Sora和WildScrape。 组大小范围从Sora的56个视频到Lavie的1400个视频. 我们保留了所提供的真实视频池,而不建造更多的真实的配对。 真实视频在3 fps(约14 s)时的中位数为41帧. 对于生成的视频,每集的中位数从8帧(HotShot)到450帧(Sora)不等,为8–50 fps. 大部分制作的视频上1–4s,而Sora的视频大约长15s. 尽管帧率可以在GenVideo中起到快捷键的作用,但MARS的语义路径分数框架独立于其间距,样本只来自真帧,在GenVideo上仍然单独达到93.59%的AUROC(Tab. S13),与全MARS(93.44 % )相当,因此MARS的传输不需要这个提示.

blocks.en:
DF26 [ 29 ] contributes 2,691 videos,
comprising 271 authentic recordings and 2,420 generated videos.
The authentic recordings show people speaking in three settings: direct-to-camera recordings (100), official statements (71), and studio interviews (100). The generated videos cover ten generator or generation-mode groups from seven model families: Grok Imagine, HunyuanVideo 1.5 (T2V and I2V), Kling 3.0, LTX 2.3 (T2V and I2V), Veo 3.1, Wan 2.2 (T2V and I2V), and Wan 2.6. Each group contains between 197 and 271 videos. We use the provided evaluation set and authentic-video pool without constructing additional pairings. All videos have a resolution of 1280 × 720 1280\times 720 and last 4–6 s, with 81 to 150 frames at 16–30 fps.

包括271项录音和2 420项制作的录像。
真实录音显示人们在三种场合发言:直接对镜头录音(100),正式声明(71)和录音室采访(100). 制作的影片包括来自七个模范家庭的十个发电机组或代模组: Grok imagine,HunyuanVideo 1.5(T2V和I2V),Kling 3.0,LTX 2.3(T2V和I2V),Veo 3.1,Wan 2.2(T2V和I2V),Wan 2.6. 每组包含197至271个视频. 我们使用所提供的评价集和真实录像池,而不建造更多的配对。 所有视频的分辨率为1280×720 1280\times 720和最后4–6s,在16–30 fps时有81至150帧.

blocks.zh: 表S2:用于培训和评价的数据集摘要。 视频计数报告每个选定的拆分,而分辨率,帧率,持续时间和帧计数则在预处理前描述原始视频(帧计数为中位数). 对于GenVideo,对真视频和假视频分别给出数值;假持续时间描述大多数生成的视频,假帧计数是每生成者中位数的范围. - 表示未报告的测量。

blocks.en: Appendix C Shared Training and Evaluation Protocol
blocks.zh: 附录C 共享培训和评价议定书

blocks.en: All methods, including ours, are trained and evaluated within a single pipeline, so that they differ only in their networks and training objectives.
blocks.zh: 所有方法,包括我们的方法,都是在单一的管道内训练和评价的,因此它们只在网络和培训目标上有所不同。

blocks.en: Each video is decoded in full, and every second frame is retained. Following UNITE [ 14 ] , the retained frames are split into consecutive, non-overlapping clips of 64 frames, each treated as one sample that carries the label of its source video. A clip with fewer than 64 frames, which occurs at the end of a video or for videos shorter than one clip, is padded by repeating its last frame, and a mask marking the padded frames is provided to the network. Frames are used in full, without face cropping or data augmentation, and are resized to the input resolution of each method’s encoder and normalized with that encoder’s statistics.
blocks.zh: 每段视频全部解码,保留每秒帧. 继UNITE [14] 之后,所保留的帧被分为连续的,非重叠的64帧片段,每个片段都作为带有其源视频标签的样本处理. 短于64帧的片段,在视频结尾或短于一个片段的片段发生,通过重复其最后一段片段来加插,并向网络提供标记片段的面具. 框架被完全使用,没有面部裁剪或数据扩充,并被调整为每种方法编码器的输入分辨率,并与编码器的统计数据正常化。

blocks.en: Unless stated otherwise, every method is trained on the FaceForensics++ c23 training split together with the GTA-V training sequences, while the FaceForensics++ validation split is used for model selection. Optimization uses AdamW [ 18 ] with a learning rate of 10 − 4 10^{-4} , a weight decay of 10 − 4 10^{-4} , and ( β 1 , β 2 ) = ( 0.9 , 0.999 ) (\beta_{1},\beta_{2})=(0.9,0.999) , halving the learning rate every 1,000 optimizer steps. Each step uses an effective batch of 32 clips, with gradient accumulation for methods whose memory footprint requires smaller micro-batches, and gradients are clipped to a norm of 1.0. Training runs for three epochs in bfloat16 mixed precision on four NVIDIA A40 GPUs with distributed data parallelism. After each epoch, the model is evaluated on the FaceForensics++ validation videos, and the epoch with the highest video-level AUROC is retained. The main results use a fixed seed, which fixes both the data order and the initialization of all trainable parameters.
blocks.zh: 除非另有说明,每一种方法在FaceForensics+c23训练上都与GTA-V训练序列并列训练,而FaceForensics+验证分裂则用于模型选择. 优化使用 AdamW [18],学习率为10−4 10^{-4},体重衰减为10−4 10^{-4},(β 1,β 2) = (0.9, 0.999) (\β_{1},\β_{2}) = (0.9,0.999),将学习率减半,每1000个优化步骤. 每一步使用有效批次的32片片段,对内存足迹需要较小的微巴的方法进行梯度累积,梯度被剪到1.0的规范. 在分布式数据平行的4个NVIDIA A40 GPU上,培训为3个时间段的bfloat16混合精度。 每个纪元之后,模型在FaceForensics++验证视频上进行评估,具有最高视频级别AUROC的纪元被保留. 主要结果使用固定的种子,既可以固定数据顺序,又可以确定所有可训练参数的初始化.

blocks.en: At test time, every clip of a video is scored, and the video score is the mean of its clip probabilities of being fake, so that each video contributes once regardless of its length. AUROC, AP, and EER are then computed over the videos of each dataset.
blocks.zh: 在测试时间,每段视频的片段都得分,视频分数是其片段假冒概率的平均值,这样,无论长度大小,每段视频都会贡献一次. 然后在每个数据集的视频中计算AUROC、AP和EER。

blocks.en: Appendix D Compared Methods
blocks.zh: 附录D 方法

blocks.en: Each compared method is implemented within the shared pipeline of Appendix C : we use its network and training objective from the original paper and released code, except where noted, while inputs, optimization, model selection, and evaluation follow the shared protocol. For methods that classify individual frames, the clip logit is the mean of the frame logits. Tab. S3 summarizes the configuration of each method.
blocks.zh: 每一个比较方法都在附录C的共享管道中实施:我们使用其网络和培训目标从原始纸张和发布代码中选择,但有注释的除外,而投入、优化、模型选择和评价则遵循共享协议。 对于分类单个帧的方法,剪辑日志是帧日志的平均值. Tab. S3总结了每种方法的配置.

blocks.en: MARS splits a single frozen PE-Core-L encoder [ 3 ] at 336 × 336 336\times 336 after block 12 into the residual and semantic paths described in Sec. 3 . The residual path processes all 64 frames of a clip, whereas the semantic path passes 16 frames through the whole encoder with its own trainable copies of the LayerNorm parameters, and a gate combines the scores of the two paths. The model is trained with a cross-entropy loss on each path and on the fused prediction.
blocks.zh: MARS在12区之后的336x336x336\times336分拆一个单一的冷冻PE-Core-L编码器,进入第3区描述的剩余和语义路径. 剩余路径处理一个剪辑的全部64帧,而语义路径则通过整个编码器的16帧,并带有自己的可训练副本的LayerNorm参数,一个门将两个路径的分数结合在一起. 该模型在每条路径和引信预测上都受到交叉内损的训练。

blocks.en:
UNITE [ 14 ] encodes each frame with a frozen SigLIP-so400m encoder [ 39 ] at 384 × 384 384\times 384 and models time with a four-block per-token temporal transformer over the 64 frames of a clip, followed by attention pooling over tokens and
a linear classifier. It is trained with cross-entropy and the attention-diversity loss, each weighted by 0.5.
blocks.zh:
UNITE [14] 将每个帧编码为冷冻的SigLIP-so400m编码器[39],编码为384×384384\时,模型时间为每盒四块时间变压器,超过64帧的剪辑,然后将注意力集中到信物上,
线性分类器。 其培训内容包括跨度和注意力多样性损失,每部分加权0.5。

blocks.en:
GenD [ 38 ] tunes only the normalization layers of the PE-Core-L encoder [ 3 ] at 336 × 336 336\times 336 and classifies the L2-normalized pooled feature of each frame with a linear layer. It is trained with cross-entropy together with the
uniformity and label-aware alignment losses on the unit sphere, weighted by 0.5 and 0.1, respectively.
blocks.zh:
GenD [38] 只调PE-Core-L编码器的正常化层 [3] 在336 × 336 336\times 336上,并将每个帧的L2-正常化集合特征以线性层分类. 训练有素的 交叉进化与
单位球体的统一性和识别标签的对齐性损失,分别加权0.5和0.1.

blocks.en: ForAda [ 7 ] steers a frozen CLIP ViT-L/14 [ 24 ] at 224 × 224 224\times 224 with a side adapter, built from the first eight blocks of a ViT-Tiny that reads the frame at 256 × 256 256\times 256 . The adapter produces attention biases through which 128 learnable query tokens attend to the CLIP patch tokens, and the resulting queries are mapped to the frame logit, with the whole model trained by cross-entropy.
blocks.zh: ForAda [7]在224×2242/224\times 224时驾驶一个冷冻的CLIP ViT-L/14 [24],并配有一个侧式适配器,由ViT-Tiny的前8个区块建造,它读取了256×256\times 256. 适配器产生注意力偏差,通过这种偏差,128个可学习的查询符会到CLIP补丁符上,由此产生的查询会映射到帧的日志上,整个模型通过交叉切换来训练.

blocks.en: DFD-HR [ 31 ] views each frame at 448 × 448 448\times 448 as one global 224 × 224 224\times 224 view and a 2 × 2 2\times 2 grid of 224 × 224 224\times 224 tiles, which pass through a frozen CLIP ViT-L/14 [ 24 ] equipped with four-expert mixture-of-experts adapters after the attention and MLP of every block. In blocks 21–23, a layer router allows a view to exit early and a token router forwards the top 75% of tokens, after which the global class token and a query-attention summary of the four tile class tokens are classified jointly. The model is trained with cross-entropy and the token-ranking loss, the latter weighted by 0.1.
blocks.zh: DFD-HR [31] 将每个帧在448×448 448\time448看成一个全球224×224\time224的视野和2×2 2⁄2\time2的网格224×224\time224的瓦片,通过一个冰冻的CLIP VIT-L/14 [24] ,在每个区块的注意和MLP后,配备了四位专家混合适配器. 在21–23号区块中,一层路由器允许提早退出,一个标志性路由器转发到前75%的路由器,之后全球级的路由符和四个瓦级的路由符的查询-注意摘要被共同分类. 该型号的训练有交叉进取和象征性级损失,后者加权0.1.

blocks.en:
DeMamba [ 4 ] fully fine-tunes an X-CLIP B/16 encoder [ 21 ] at 224 × 224 224\times 224 , which exchanges messages among groups of eight consecutive frames. Its global
branch averages the class tokens over the clip, while its detail branch reads the tokens of each spatial zone across frames with a Mamba block, and the two branches are combined into one logit trained with binary cross-entropy.
blocks.zh:
DeMamba [4] 完全微调 X-CLIP B/16编码器 [21] 在 224 × 224 224\times 224 ,该编码器在连续8帧的分组之间交换消息. 全球
分支在片段上平均分级符号,而其细节分支用一个曼巴块读取每个跨帧空间区的符号,两个分支被合并成一个以二进制交叉切换训练的日志.

blocks.en: Effort [ 36 ] applies singular value decomposition to the query, key, value, and output projections of every block of a frozen CLIP ViT-L/14 [ 24 ] at 224 × 224 224\times 224 , freezing the principal singular directions and training a rank-one residual, and classifies the class token of each frame with a linear layer. It is trained with cross-entropy together with the orthogonality and singular-value constraints of the paper, weighted by 1.0.

blocks.en:
ReStraV [ 12 ] encodes each frame with a frozen DINOv2
ViT-S/14 [ 22 ] at 224 × 224 224\times 224 and treats the normalized tokens of successive frames as a trajectory. Twenty-one statistics of the step lengths and turning angles along this trajectory are standardized and classified by a two-layer MLP trained with binary cross-entropy.

VIT-S/14 [22] at 224×224 224\times 224,并将相继帧的常态符记视为轨迹. 沿着这一轨迹的步长和转角的21个统计被标准化,并由一个受过二进制交叉交替训练的双层MLP进行分类.

blocks.en: F.1 Residual Extraction Depth and Backbone
blocks.zh: F.1 残余开采深度和背骨

blocks.en: We move the split of the residual path from block 12 to blocks 6, 18, and 24 ( Tab. S4 ). Block 12 gives the best generated-video mean and seven-dataset average, whereas later splits at blocks 18 and 24 improve facial manipulation by about 1% but lower generated video by up to 8%. An earlier split at block 6 lowers both. This suggests that cues of generated video are best exposed in intermediate features, which still retain local detail, while deeper features become more semantic and favor facial manipulation, consistent with the observation that the strongest PE features lie inside the network rather than at its output [ 3 ] .
blocks.zh: 我们把剩余路径从第12区移到第6、第18和第24区(Tab.S4)。 12区给出了最佳生成视频平均值和7数据集平均值,而后来在18区和24区拆分后,面部操纵率提高了约1%,但生成视频却降低了8%。 更早在6区拆分 两者都较低 这表明生成的视频的提示在中间特性中最能曝光,这些特性仍然保留了局部细节,而更深的特性则变得更加语义化,更倾向于面部操纵,这与最强的PE特性存在于网络内部而非其输出[3]的观察是一致的.

blocks.en:
We also replace PE-Core-L with SigLIP-so400m [ 39 ] , trained with image–text contrastive learning, and DINOv3-L [ 30 ] , trained with self-supervision on images for dense prediction. Both keep facial manipulation within about 5% of PE but drop generated video by more than 40%, below chance.
One possible contributor is that PE-Core is also trained on video, whereas SigLIP and DINOv3 are image-only, although other differences in data and objectives remain uncontrolled. Overall, we observe that the residual design transfers to facial manipulation across backbones, but its generated-video performance depends on the pretraining of the encoder.
blocks.zh:
我们还将PE-Core-L替换为SigLIP-so400m[39],经过图像-文本对比性学习培训,DINov3-L[30],经过图像成密预测自导自演培训。 两人将面部操纵控制在PE的5%左右,但将生成的视频降低40%以上,低于概率.
一个可能的贡献者是PE-Core也接受过视频培训,而SigLIP和DINov3则只进行图像培训,尽管数据和目标上的其他差异仍然不受控制. 总体来说,我们观察到,剩余设计转移到跨骨干面部操纵,但其生成的视频性能取决于编码器的预训.

blocks.en: F.3 Fairness of Comparisons

blocks.en: F.5 Learned Gate versus Fixed Fusion Weights
blocks.zh: F.5 学习门对固定组合重量

blocks.en: We replace the learned gate with constant weights at inference, keeping both trained paths and their margin normalization unchanged ( Tab. S7 ). Fixed weights favor different categories: equal weighting gives the highest facial AUROC, while w = 0.75 w=0.75 gives the highest generated-video AUROC. The learned gate achieves the highest overall AUROC at 91.43% and the lowest EER at 13.26%, compared with 91.35% and 13.65% for equal weighting. We retain the learned gate because it allows the contribution of each path to vary across clips without selecting a fixed mixture weight, although its overall improvement over equal weighting is negligible.

blocks.en: G.1 Average Precision
blocks.zh: G.1 平均精度

blocks.en:
Tab. S11 reports AP, which measures how many of the videos ranked as fake are actually fake. AP follows the same pattern as AUROC: MARS achieves the highest average in both training settings (95.57 and 95.15), followed by DFD-HR (92.30 and 93.90), while the remaining methods trail by at least 5.9 points. The largest gap appears on GenVideo, where MARS reaches 92.99 AP against at most 79.10 for the baselines.
In contrast, DF26 compresses the differences between methods: since 90% of its videos are fake, a random detector already reaches an AP of about 90, and even DeMamba, near chance in AUROC, scores above 90. Overall, AP confirms the AUROC ranking, but on imbalanced sets such as DF26 it largely reflects the share of fake videos, which makes AUROC and EER the more informative metrics there.
blocks.zh:
Tab. S11报道了AP,它测量了有多少被评为假的视频实际上是假的. AP遵循与AUROC相同的模式:MARS在两种训练环境都实现了最高的平均值(95.57和95.15),其次是DFD-HR(92.30和93.90),而其余的方法则至少领先5.9分. 最大的差距出现在GenVideo上,MARS达到92.99 AP,而基线最多达到79.10。
相比之下,DF26压缩了不同方法的差异:由于其90%的视频是假的,随机探测器已经达到了大约90的AP,甚至DeMamba在AUROC中也接近机会,得分超过90. 总体来说,AP证实了AUROC的排名,但在DF26等不平衡的套装上,它在很大程度上反映了假视频的比例,这使得AUROC和EER成为了那里更丰富的衡量标准.

blocks.en: G.2 Generator-Level EER
blocks.zh: G.2 发电机级

blocks.en:
As shown in Tab. S12 , MARS achieves the lowest EER on all ten GenVideo generators and on six of the ten DF26 groups, while DFD-HR remains stronger on Wan2.2 I2V and both LTX2.3 modes, and GenD on Grok Imagine. DF26 is harder than GenVideo for all methods, with the lowest EER above 20 on eight of its ten groups, compared with two of ten on GenVideo. Interestingly, the hardest generators differ between detectors: MARS has a higher mean EER on the open-source DF26 groups than on the commercial ones (30.94 vs. 26.78), whereas DFD-HR shows the opposite trend (28.35 vs. 34.69), suggesting that the two methods rely on partly different cues.
Overall, we observe that the advantage of MARS holds across the GenVideo generators but not across the more recent DF26 generators, where no single detector is best on every group.
blocks.zh:
如塔布所示. S12,MARS在所有十台GenVideo发电机上和十台DF26组中的六台上实现了最低EER,而DFD-HR在Wan2.2 I2V和LTX2.3两种模式上仍保持较强,Grok imagine上的GenD. DF26对于所有方法来说都比GenVideo更难,在其10个组中的8个组中,EER最低的均高于20,而GenVideo上只有2个组. 有趣的是,最困难的发电机在探测器之间有所不同:MARS在开源DF26组中的平均EER比在商业组中(30.94对26.78)要高,而DFD-HR则显示出相反的趋势(28.35对34.69),说明两种方法依赖部分不同的提示.
总的来说,我们观察到,MARS的优势存在于GenVideo发电机上,但并不存在于最近的DF26发电机上,因为每组发电机上没有一个单一的探测器最好。

blocks.en: G.5 Robustness by Dataset
blocks.zh: G.5 数据集的强度

blocks.en: We apply each degradation to decoded frames at their native resolution, before encoder-specific resizing and normalization. All methods use their main-table checkpoints (a fixed seed), without additional training. JPEG compression uses Pillow quality levels of 80, 60, 40, 20, and 10. Following GenD [ 38 ] , Gaussian blur uses standard deviations of 0.5, 1, 1.5, 2, and 3 pixels, with respective kernel sizes of 5, 7, 11, 13, and 19 and reflective padding.
blocks.zh: 在编码器的特异性调整大小和正常化之前,我们用每个降解来解码其原生分辨率的帧。 所有方法都使用其主桌式检查站(固定种子),不经过额外培训。 JPEG压缩使用Pillow质量水平为80,60,40,20和10. 在GenD [38]之后,高斯模糊使用0.5,1,1.5,2和3像素的标准偏差,相应的内核大小为5,7,11,13和19并反射制垫.

blocks.en:
Downscaling reduces the short side to 224, 112, or 64 pixels using bilinear interpolation with antialiasing, preserving the aspect ratio. Gaussian noise uses standard deviations of 0.01, 0.03, 0.05, 0.1, and 0.2 on pixel values in [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] , followed by clipping and 8-bit quantization. Noise is seeded by video identifier and clip index so that every method
receives the same perturbation.

缩放将短边缩小到224,112,或64像素,使用双线插值与反斜拉比,保留了宽比. 高斯噪声在像素值上使用0.01,0.03,0.05,0.1和0.2的标准偏差在[0,1] [0,1]中,然后进行剪切和8位的量化. 噪声通过视频识别码和剪辑索引播种,以便每一种方法
得到同样的扰动。

blocks.en: G.6 Faithfulness by Dataset
blocks.zh: G.6 数据集的忠诚度

blocks.en: For each dataset, we select up to 100 manipulated clips that MARS predicts as fake and up to 100 authentic clips. We use the first clip of each selected video and require more than 16 valid frames. Selecting detected manipulated clips explains why the initial AUROC is close to 100%.
blocks.zh: 对于每个数据集,我们选择最多100个MARS预测为假冒的被操纵的片段,最多100个真实片段. 我们使用每一段视频的第一个片段,需要超过16个有效的帧。 选择检测到的被操纵的剪辑可以解释为什么最初的AUROC接近100%.

blocks.en: We replace the highest-ranked k ∈ { 8 , 16 , 32 , 64 } k\in\{8,16,32,64\} patches with each frame’s mean color. Each patch covers 14 × 14 14\times 14 pixels, and the same positions are replaced in every frame. The random control replaces the same number of patches on the same clips using a fixed random seed. We rerun the detector after each edit and compute AUROC using one clip per selected video.

blocks.en: As shown in Fig. S10 , ranked removal reduces detection performance more than random removal, particularly on FF++, CelebDF, and UADFV. The effect is smaller on GenVideo, which may reflect evidence spread across more of the scene. This test measures the relevance of selected patches to the prediction, not whether they match the actual manipulated regions.

blocks.en:
We use clips with a manipulated segment in the middle, giving 560 clips for each segment length. For a segment of length L L , we remove L / 4 L/4 , L / 2 L/2 , or L L frames using three choices: the highest frame scores, random frames, or known manipulated frames (oracle).
The remaining frames keep their original order and are packed together with an updated validity mask before MARS is run again.
For the 16-frame segments, removing the 16 highest-scoring frames lowers the mean fake probability from 24.45% to 19.42%, compared with 24.89% for random removal and 14.53% for oracle removal ( Fig. S11 ). Removing frames also changes the temporal spacing between the remaining frames and the frames sampled by the semantic path, where random removal of the same number of frames introduces the same changes, so the larger drop under ranked removal cannot be attributed to them. Ranked removal moves the prediction closer to the authentic reference, but the gap to oracle removal shows that the ranking does not identify every manipulated frame.
